topic: 媒体、信息与证据 · Independent new scenario: changes in work and professional autonomy
grammarFocus: 转述动词；引述与改写；限定词 some / most / all 的范围。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: Workplace Autonomy and the Evidence of Change
instructions: 本材料为原创模拟练习，不是官方雅思试题，也不对应任何官方分数。请先听/读对话，完成10道听力题；再学习语法讲解，完成8道语法题；最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。听力题和阅读题题干与选项均为英文，解释为中文。
transcript:
Maya: So, how was the first week with the new scheduling system?

Daniel: Honestly? Mixed. Some things are better, but most of the changes feel like they were decided without us.

Maya: What do you mean? I thought the whole point was to give teams more control over their hours.

Daniel: That's what the email said. But when I asked my manager, she told me that all requests still have to go through her. So we fill in a form, and she approves or rejects it.

Maya: Hmm. That doesn't sound like autonomy to me. Did she explain why?

Daniel: She said the company needs to make sure there are enough people on the floor at busy times. I get that. But she also claimed that most staff prefer having a manager check their requests. I'm not sure that's true.

Maya: Did anyone ask the staff?

Daniel: Not that I know of. That's the problem. She said, 'We consulted everyone,' but I never saw a survey. Maybe some people were asked. I don't know.

Maya: So what are you going to do?

Daniel: I'm thinking of writing a short note to the team. I'll ask people whether they were consulted, and I'll suggest that we share the results with management. If most people say they weren't asked, that's evidence.

Maya: That's a good idea. But be careful with the wording. If you write 'management ignored us', people will get defensive. Maybe say 'we would like to understand how the decision was made'.

Daniel: Right. And I should avoid saying 'everyone agrees with me'. I don't know that yet.

Maya: Exactly. Use words like 'some' and 'many' until you have the numbers. Then you can say 'most' or 'all' if the data supports it.

Daniel: Okay. I'll draft something tonight and send it to you before I post it.

Maya: Good. And Daniel — remember, the goal is a conversation, not a fight.

Daniel: I know. Thanks, Maya.

questions.prompt: What is Daniel's main feeling about the new scheduling system?
options: He thinks all changes are excellent.
He feels the changes are mixed and some were made without staff input.
He believes the system gives teams full control.
He wants to leave the company immediately.
answers: He feels the changes are mixed and some were made without staff input.
questions.explanation: Daniel 说 'Mixed. Some things are better, but most of the changes feel like they were decided without us.' 表明他的感受是混合的，且多数改变感觉未经员工参与。
questions.evidence: Mixed. Some things are better, but most of the changes feel like they were decided without us.

questions.prompt: According to Daniel, what did his manager say about requests?
options: All requests still have to go through her.
Staff can change hours without any form.
Only some requests need a form.
answers: All requests still have to go through her.
questions.explanation: Daniel 转述经理的话：'she told me that all requests still have to go through her.' 因此所有请求仍需经过经理。
questions.evidence: she told me that all requests still have to go through her.

questions.prompt: What reason did the manager give for needing approval?
options: To make sure there are enough people on the floor at busy times.
answers: To make sure there are enough people on the floor at busy times.
questions.explanation: Daniel 说经理的理由是 'the company needs to make sure there are enough people on the floor at busy times.'
questions.evidence: She said the company needs to make sure there are enough people on the floor at busy times.

questions.prompt: What did the manager claim about staff preferences?
options: Most staff prefer having a manager check their requests.
All staff want to leave the company.
Some staff refuse to fill in forms.
answers: Most staff prefer having a manager check their requests.
questions.explanation: Daniel 转述：'she also claimed that most staff prefer having a manager check their requests.' 注意这是经理的说法，Daniel 并不确定。
questions.evidence: she also claimed that most staff prefer having a manager check their requests.

questions.prompt: What does Daniel plan to do?
options: Write a short note to the team asking whether they were consulted.
Send a complaint directly to the CEO.
Ignore the issue and continue working.
Ask Maya to speak to his manager.
answers: Write a short note to the team asking whether they were consulted.
questions.explanation: Daniel 说 'I'm thinking of writing a short note to the team. I'll ask people whether they were consulted...'
questions.evidence: I'm thinking of writing a short note to the team. I'll ask people whether they were consulted

questions.prompt: What wording does Maya suggest Daniel avoid?
questions.explanation: Maya 说 'If you write 'management ignored us', people will get defensive.' 她建议避免这种措辞。
questions.evidence: If you write 'management ignored us', people will get defensive.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word from the conversation: Daniel says he should avoid saying 'everyone ______ with me'.
questions.explanation: Daniel 说 'I should avoid saying 'everyone agrees with me'.' 因此填 agrees。
questions.evidence: I should avoid saying 'everyone agrees with me'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with one word: Maya says, 'Use words like 'some' and 'many' until you have the ______.'
questions.explanation: Maya 说 'Use words like 'some' and 'many' until you have the numbers.' 因此填 numbers。
questions.evidence: Use words like 'some' and 'many' until you have the numbers.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Daniel saw a survey showing that some people were asked about the changes.
questions.explanation: Daniel 说 'Maybe some people were asked. I don't know.' 文中没有提供 Daniel 是否看到调查的证据，因此是 Not Given。
questions.evidence: Maybe some people were asked. I don't know.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Daniel has already sent the note to the team.
questions.explanation: Daniel 说 'I'll draft something tonight and send it to you before I post it.' 表明他还没有发送，因此是 False。
questions.evidence: I'll draft something tonight and send it to you before I post it.

grammar.title: 转述动词；引述与改写；限定词 some / most / all 的范围
grammar.explanation: 转述动词（reporting verbs）用来引出别人的话，如 say, tell, claim, suggest, explain。注意：say 后面直接跟说话内容；tell 后面要跟人（tell someone that...）。引述（quotation）是原话，改写（paraphrase）是用自己的话转述，意思不变。限定词 some / most / all 表示范围大小：some 表示一部分（不确定多少），most 表示大部分（超过一半但非全部），all 表示全部。使用时要根据证据选择，不能随意夸大。
grammar.example: She said, 'We consulted everyone,' but I never saw a survey.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct reporting verb: The manager ______ that all requests must go through her.
questions.explanation: said 后面可以直接跟 that 从句；told 需要跟人（told me that...）；explained to 需要跟人；claimed to 后跟动词原形。因此选 said。
questions.evidence: She said the company needs to make sure there are enough people on the floor at busy times.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: Daniel ______ me that he would draft a note.
questions.explanation: tell 后面需要跟人（told me that...）；say 不直接跟人。因此选 told。
questions.evidence: I'll draft something tonight and send it to you before I post it.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is a correct paraphrase of 'Most staff prefer having a manager check their requests'?
options: A large part of the staff like a manager to check their requests.
All staff like a manager to check their requests.
No staff like a manager to check their requests.
Some staff dislike having a manager check their requests.
answers: A large part of the staff like a manager to check their requests.
questions.explanation: most 表示大部分，改写为 'a large part of' 意思相近；all 表示全部，some 表示一部分，均不准确。
questions.evidence: she also claimed that most staff prefer having a manager check their requests.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct determiner: ______ people were asked, but I don't know how many.
questions.explanation: 因为不知道具体数量，用 some 表示一部分；most 和 all 都表示较大范围，every 后接单数名词。
questions.evidence: Maybe some people were asked. I don't know.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct determiner: ______ the changes feel like they were decided without us.
questions.explanation: 原文用 'most of the changes' 表示大部分改变；some of 表示一部分，all of 表示全部，every of 错误。
questions.evidence: most of the changes feel like they were decided without us.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct reporting verb: Maya ______ that Daniel should be careful with the wording.
questions.explanation: suggest 后面可以跟 that 从句，表示建议；said to 需要跟人；told that 缺少宾语；spoke 不接 that 从句。
questions.evidence: But be careful with the wording.

options: All requests still have to go through her.
All request still have to go through her.
All of requests still have to go through her.
All the request still have to go through her.
answers: All requests still have to go through her.
questions.explanation: all 直接修饰复数名词 requests，不需要 of；all of 后需加 the 或限定词。
questions.evidence: all requests still have to go through her.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: Daniel said he ______ write a note to the team.
questions.explanation: 转述过去将来的计划时，will 变为 would。
questions.evidence: I'll draft something tonight and send it to you before I post it.
